Are you passionate about delivering great customer experiences and solving technical challenges?

At Trackman, we are looking for a service-minded and technically curious Customer Service Specialist to join our Business Tools Support team.

In this role, you will be a key point of contact for customers worldwide, helping them get the most out of our innovative sports technology. From troubleshooting technical issues to guiding new customers through onboarding, you will play an important role in delivering a seamless and professional customer experience.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where customer satisfaction, problem-solving, and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

Meet the Team

You will join our Business Tools Support team in EMEA, a collaborative team of six supporting the digital platforms and services used by Trackman venues worldwide, including Booking & Payments, the Trackman Portal, and venue onboarding.

Working closely with customers, Sales, Product, and Development, the team resolves technical and operational challenges and continuously improves our solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, support international customers, and contribute to delivering excellent customer experiences.

What will you be doing?

As a Customer Service Specialist, you will combine customer service with hands-on technical support. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone and email, providing professional, friendly, and efficient assistance.

• 
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues related to Trackman products, software, and connected devices.

• 
Customer Onboarding: Guide new customers through product setup, configuration, and usage, ensuring they feel confident using our solutions.

• 
Product Guidance: Educate customers on product features, updates, and best practices to help them get the most out of Trackman technology.

• 
Case Management: Handle multiple support requests, prioritize effectively, and maintain accurate documentation in our support system.

• 
Follow-up & Customer Satisfaction: Proactively follow up on customer cases to ensure successful resolutions and positive experiences.

• 
Collaboration & Improvement: Work closely with colleagues and other departments to resolve complex issues, share knowledge, and continuously improve our support processes.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people, has a natural interest in technology, and thrives in a dynamic, international environment.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Previous experience in customer service, technical support, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably within a technology-related industry.

• 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A customer-focused mindset with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

• 
Confidence working with Windows operating systems, computers, and common technical devices such as monitors, projectors, and mobile devices.

• 
Experience with ticketing or customer support systems, preferably Zendesk.

• 
The ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high level of service in a busy environment.

• 
A proactive, structured, and collaborative approach to your work.

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• 
An interest in sports, particularly golf, baseball, or sports technology.

• 
Basic knowledge of networking and connectivity.

• 
Experience with remote troubleshooting and technical diagnostics.

• 
Additional education or training in IT, customer service, or a related field.

• 
Flexibility to work weekends when required.

Most importantly, you are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by making a difference for customers.

What can we offer?

At Trackman, you will become part of an international technology company where innovation, sports, and passion come together.

You will have the opportunity to work with advanced sports technology used by athletes, coaches, and organizations worldwide, alongside talented and dedicated colleagues.

We offer a collaborative working environment, opportunities to develop your technical and customer service skills, and a culture where initiative, ownership, and new ideas are valued.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

If you are excited about combining technology, customer service, and sports, we would love to hear from you!

For additional information about the position, please contact Jade Palphreyman, Business Tools Lead EMEA, at japa@trackman.com.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

**CTT Member

**

• Participate and represent Biostatistics

• Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• Review and approve the CSR

• Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Requirements

**

• MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience in working with clinical trials

• Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials

• Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently as well as in teams

• Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner

• Proactive and open-minded

• Ability to prioritize and work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Result and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$130,560.00---$195,840.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Are you an expert in ensuring uptime and high quality in a Data Center, or would you like to become one? Then here is a unique opportunity to oversee the operation and maintenance of multiple data centers!

If you have the following, this job is for you:

• Technical education: It can be as a marine engineer, electrician, refrigeration technician, energy technologist, automation technologist or similar

• Relevant experience with Critical Facilities: e.g., Electrical, mechanical, generators, automation, HVAC, buildings automation etc.

• Practical experience with troubleshooting and servicing technical installations

• Experience from operations in a technical environment - preferably data centers

• Meeting customer and government security screening requirements are required for this role

About the role and the team

GlobalConnect operates 11 data centers in Denmark and even more in the other countries where GlobalConnect is present. In addition to the ongoing operation and maintenance of our existing Data centers, there are also large expansions in the pipeline. As our new Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer, you will be part of the Site Operations department with over 45 skilled team members, with colleagues in Norway, Finland, Sweden, Denmark and Germany and with employees from many nationalities, enabling you to work in a multinational environment.

Site Operations Denmark is a workplace with focus on a good working environment. We focus on professional and personal well-being and emphasize good working relationships. Through your work as a Critical Facilities, you will have the chance to engage with every facet of managing a data center. You will experience flexibility in relation to your everyday life and a large degree of freedom under responsibility. You can also expect that most days you will be met with exciting projects and tasks that ensures no workdays are the same.

Moreover, you will have an important role being an essential part of the rotational 24x7 on-call system, also having the requirement to work overtime, reflecting the continuous nature of data center operations as a Data Center never sleeps. Based on these requirements, it would therefore also be beneficial if you are able to reach our Taastrup site within approx. 45 minutes.

Key Responsibilities and what you will do during a typical week:

• Preventive & Corrective Maintenance: Perform rounds and inspections to conduct preventive and corrective maintenance on critical systems. Inspect and test important equipment such as backup generators, cooling systems, UPS batteries, and electrical panels to ensure optimal performance and early detection of faults.

• Physical Monitoring & Inspections: Carry out daily inspections on infrastructure components to assess technical performance, environmental conditions, and compliance with safety and operational standards.

• Incident & Emergency Response: Monitor and respond rapidly to system alerts, alarms, and emergencies.

• Complex Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and assist with repairing of complex issues across electrical, mechanical, and control systems. Apply systematic problem-solving techniques and escalate when needed.

• Change Management: Support the execution and documentation of system changes, following established Change Management protocols to minimize operational risk.

• Vendor Supervision: Coordinate and supervise external vendors to ensure adherence to operational procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards during maintenance or installation work.

Who we are looking for

You are a dedicated professional with a strong commitment to operational excellence and safety in Mission critical environments. With a blend of technical knowledge and hands-on experience, you are skilled at handling complex systems and processes and thrive in roles where critical infrastructure demands unwavering attention. You are detail-oriented, quick to respond to emergencies, and focused on developing and adhering to robust procedures. Your adaptability and communication skills enable you to work effectively with team members, vendors, and contractors alike.

Job Description

Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Senior Business Consultant, you will specialize in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Business Consultant with an interest in digitalization and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analyzing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals, where you will contribute with your established domain expertise, while continuously expanding your knowledge of IT solutions within banking and investment. As a part of the emerging team in Aarhus, you will become a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analyzing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimization.

• 
Co-leading the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management.

• 
Acting as a Subject Matter Expert, leveraging in-depth domain knowledge to drive project outcomes, provide expert guidance, and facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• 
Have extensive experience within the banking sector and especially the investment domain, ideally working at the intersection of IT, business, and organization.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalization, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have comprehensive experience with investment-related processes. Previous experience within banking or investment is a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. Job Description

Are you passionate about IT and interested in building a career within mainframe technology? As an IT Consultant, you will work with the development and maintenance of mainframe solutions that support our core banking platform. You will collaborate with experienced colleagues, develop your technical skills and gain specialized knowledge of business-critical banking systems. Previous mainframe experience is an advantage, but your motivation to learn and grow is what matters most.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for an IT Consultant to join our team, working with the mainframe solutions at the heart of our core banking platform. You will be involved in developing, maintaining and improving the applications that support our customers' daily banking operations, including payments and investments. Working with experienced colleagues across teams and countries, you will gain hands-on experience with mainframe technology and develop a strong understanding of the systems behind modern banking.

You will join a team that will support your onboarding and help you build your expertise within mainframe technology. While previous experience is an advantage, your motivation to learn and develop is what matters most. Over time, you will take on increasing responsibility for developing and maintaining our core banking solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Developing and maintaining mainframe applications that form part of our core banking platform.

• Working with mainframe technologies and tools to improve existing applications and develop new functionality.

• Understanding business requirements and translating them into technical solutions that meet our customers' needs.

• Collaborating with colleagues across teams and countries, contributing to agile ways of working and continuous improvement.

• Supporting the stability, performance and reliability of systems that handle critical banking operations, including payments and investments.

About you

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. **

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Engineers - Substations and Export Cables
jobs.description:
Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

We are looking for several Senior Project Engineers to strengthen our offshore transmission engineering capabilities within Business Area Wind, Offshore, Engineering.

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

We welcome engineers from all relevant disciplines across these scopes, with particular interest in HV and LV systems for onshore and offshore substations, and civil engineering for onshore substations and onshore export cable routes. Your assigned scope will reflect your background and experience.

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

• 
Apply a systems engineering mindset so decisions within your scope support the performance, integration, optimisation and delivery of the overall transmission system—not individual contracts in isolation.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

• On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
• The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
• You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.
AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

• How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
• How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
• What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?
This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
• Other relevant documents
Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

• Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
• Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
• Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
